messages.author: 8bf0927cf6c5a784
messages.subject: region-based analysis
parts:
I am trying to understand how methylKit handles region-based analysis. I used read() with resolution="region". How are those regions defined? When I get to the methylDiff object, all the rows are 1 bp long, so it doesn't look like region-based analysis was actually performed.

I see there is also tileMethylCounts() that allows you to define tiling windows. That option makes more sense. Is that related to the resolution setting in read()? Should those be used together? What is the relationship between the two region settings?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] region-based analysis
parts: Resolution is a tag for the object and should be generally set by regional analysis functions and not by the users since most users will start with base pair resolution data. If you somehow regional data stored in a text file then you can use resolution arguments otherwise regional analysis functions will set it
